name: Takashina Sarafumi
source: Due to his showy nature and dancing ability, Sarafumi is an Al Jeanne; a star among other Jeannes that take on main roles. As such, he's seen as the face of his class, the Quartz group. He hates stuffy formalities and is always lighthearted but at the same time, he has a sharp intuition and observes people closely. During his first year, he joined forces with Univers' legendary Tachibana Tsuki and they shone brightly upon stage. That experience is now a darkness growing in his heart.
